instrument_name: W. Va. SB 841 (2024 Regular Session) enrolled committee substitute - amends 21A-1A-28 Wages
figure_or_rule_carried: SUI taxable wage base 9,500 USD per employee per calendar year (fixed amount; replaces the 2009 indexed 'threshold wage' mechanism, which produced 9,521 for 2024 per the agency handbook). Rises only if FUTA base exceeds 9,500. Wages paid for employment in another state on which contributions were required and paid under that state's UI law count toward the 9,500 (multistate credit, MULTI-OQ-2: YES). Predecessor wages count. Amendments effective 2024-07-01. No amendment in 2026 SB 1053. NOTE: Wayback copy of code.wvlegislature.gov dated 2025-03-29 still shows the pre-2024 threshold-wage text (stale publisher copy) - enrolled act prevails.

instrument_name: W. Va. SB 1053 (2026 Regular Session) enrolled - 21A-5-5 and new 21A-9-10 Unemployment Automation and Administration Fund
figure_or_rule_carried: Passed 2026-03-14, effective 2026-07-01. 21A-5-5: new employer 2.7% of wages until 36 consecutive months, then experience rate under 21A-5-10; foreign construction-trade entity 7.5% (statute; agency handbook says 8.5% - unresolved). (d) from 2026-07-01 the otherwise applicable contribution rate is 'reduced by seven percent', not below zero. 21A-9-10(c)(1): employers with non-zero rate pay an annual fee 'equal to seven percent of the employer's total taxable wages for the twelve-month period ending the preceding June 30', Commissioner may reduce so collections stay <= 18 million USD/yr; billed by March 31, delinquent 30 days later; fee ends and full rates reimposed at 60 million USD or 2031-07-01; deposits stop if UC Fund < threshold. Literal text says 7% of taxable wages; the design (fund shift) reads as 7% of contributions - ambiguity unresolved, needs WorkForce WV notice. Employer-only; no employee deduction. Local copy now held.

instrument_name: W. Va. Code 21-5-4 Cash orders; payment upon separation (Wayback copy 2025-03-24)
figure_or_rule_carried: Final pay on discharge OR resignation: wages due for work performed before separation paid on or before the next regular payday; fringe benefits payable later under agreement terms follow the agreement; layoff/labor-dispute suspension: next regular payday; payment in person, regular channels or by mail on request (postmark date). Failure: liquidated damages 2x unpaid amount (not available for misclassification-overtime claims). Deduction from final wages for unreturned employer property >100 USD allowed only with a contemporaneous signed itemized agreement, written notice and 10-business-day return window; objection -> escrow; not under CBAs. Payment media: checks, direct deposit, payroll cards, money orders.

instrument_name: W. Va. Code 21-5C-3 Maximum hours; overtime compensation (Wayback copy 2025-03-21)
figure_or_rule_carried: Overtime 1.5x regular rate over 40 hours per workweek (no daily overtime). Regular rate includes all remuneration except gifts, pay for non-work periods, discretionary bonuses, bona fide profit-sharing/thrift, plan contributions, and qualifying premium pay (daily >8h, weekend/holiday premium >=1.5x, CBA premium) - mirrors FLSA 7(e). Belo-type contracts (guaranty <=60h) and piece-rate overtime allowed.

instrument_name: W. Va. Code 21-5C-1 Definitions (Minimum Wage and Maximum Hours Standards) (Wayback copy 2025-07-09)
figure_or_rule_carried: State MW/OT law applies to an 'employer' with 6+ employees in any calendar week at one separate, distinct and permanent location (includes the State and political subdivisions); excludes employers where 80% of employees are subject to the federal maximum-hours/overtime act. Excluded employees include: federal employees; volunteers of nonprofits; newsboys, golf caddies; traveling/outside salesmen; family employed by parent/child/spouse; bona fide executive/administrative/professional; on-the-job trainees; severely disabled in sheltered workshops; summer camp staff; persons 62+ receiving Social Security; agricultural workers (FLSA definition); state firefighters; theatre ushers; part-time students; local motorbus carrier employees; auto/truck/farm-implement/aircraft salesmen, partsmen, mechanics (OT only); DOT-regulated drivers; legislative per-diem staff; seasonal whitewater-outfitter and amusement-park employees (<7 months, OT only).

instrument_name: W. Va. Code 38-5A-3 Suggestee execution (wage garnishment) (Wayback copy 2025-02-18)
figure_or_rule_carried: Creditor wage garnishment (suggestee execution): only if weekly wages after state and federal taxes exceed 50x federal minimum hourly wage (50 x 7.25 = 362.50 USD/week, derived); levy = 20% of wages after taxes, never reducing weekly pay below 50x federal minimum wage; continuing levy up to one year; one execution satisfied at a time, juniors in priority order. Stricter than CCPA 25%/30x. Child support/tax levies governed separately.

instrument_name: WV Division of Labor - Minimum Wage & Maximum Hours page and Minimum Wage FAQ
authority: West Virginia Division of Labor, Wage & Hour Section
article_or_section: Minimum Wage FAQ; Minimum Wage & Maximum Hours page
figure_or_rule_carried: State minimum wage 8.75 USD/h since 2016-01-01 (no 2026 or enacted 2027 change shown); applies where 6+ non-exempt employees work at one separate, distinct, permanent location (counted per location; home/client residence = work location; temporary assignments = where assignments issued); out-of-state employers covered on same test; otherwise federal 7.25. Tipped: 70% tip credit, cash wage 2.62 USD/h (8.75 x 0.30 = 2.625, agency states 2.62), written tip records required, tip pool only among tip-eligible employees, employer may not share. Meal credit 4.00 USD/day for 8h shift (0.50/h if shorter) only if meal eaten, no written authorization needed. Training wage: deferred to federal (under-20, first 90 days). State overtime does not apply where 80%+ of workforce is FLSA-covered (most employers: state MW + federal OT). Statute 21-5C-2 itself not retrieved (code site geo-blocked).

instrument_name: 42 CSR 5 Legislative Rule - Wage Payment and Collection (WV Division of Labor), revised 2019-07-01
figure_or_rule_carried: 7.3: itemized statement of earnings on the scheduled payday with hourly rate or salary, hours paid, overtime rate if applicable, bonus/incentive pay if applicable, itemized deductions; paper, or electronic if the employee has direct, immediate and convenient electronic access (no separate consent rule). 5.1: payroll/employment records kept at least 5 years (name or ID, home address, DOB if under 18, occupation, regular rate, daily and weekly hours, work-authorization documentation). 4.1-4.2: written notice of work week, pay period, payday; written notice of any change in rate, pay period, method or place at least 1 full pay period before. 7.2: at least twice monthly, max 19 days between paydays (special agreement otherwise). 7.4: payday falling on closed day -> pay preceding business day. 9.1-9.2: deductions other than statutory need a written wage assignment; 75% of net wages exempt from assignment (non-state employees). 9.4: no assignment while a garnishment over 25% of net is in effect. 3.13: illegal deduction definition. Rule sunsets 2029-07-01.

instrument_name: W. Va. Code Chapter 21 Article 5 Wage Payment and Collection (full article as published by WV Division of Labor)
authority: West Virginia Division of Labor (publishing the W. Va. Code text)
figure_or_rule_carried: 21-5-1: 'wages' for final-pay purposes (21-5-4) include accrued fringe benefits capable of calculation and payable directly (fringe = vacation, holidays, sick, personal leave, incentive bonuses etc.), calculated per employer-employee agreement -> accrued vacation payout governed by policy/agreement; 'wages due' = at least all wages earned up to the 12th day before the regular payday; special agreement permits less than biweekly but never less than monthly; deductions = legally required + authorized union dues, pension, savings, credit union, charity, insurance (public employees: no union dues except grandfathered municipal CBAs). 21-5-3: settle at least twice monthly, max 19 days apart; payment by cash, check/money order, payroll card (written fee disclosure, one free withdrawal per pay period, free in-network withdrawals; must offer direct deposit option), or direct deposit to account the employee identifies (employee who gives no account details may be paid by payroll card); employer not required to use direct deposit; wage assignments max 1 year, written, employer-accepted, 75% exempt. 21-5-9: written notice at hire of rate, day, hour, place of payment; posted vacation/sick policies; itemized statement of deductions each pay period; post the Commissioner's abstract; keep wage-hour records. Source PDF carries no edition date - currency checked only by content (post-2021 union-dues amendment present).

instrument_name: WV Tax Division TSD 381 Withholding Information for Employers (Rev. September 2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: Compensation subject to federal withholding is subject to WV withholding (wages, commissions, bonuses, vacation allowances, back pay, tips, retro increases). Remit by the 15th of the following month; quarterly return (IT-101Q) by last day of month after quarter. W-2s and WV/IT-103 year-end reconciliation due January 31; EFW2 for W-2, Pub 1220 for 1099. For periods after 2024-12-31: e-filing mandatory for employers filing for 10+ employees or using a payroll service ($25 penalty per return not e-filed); any single business tax of 50,000+ in prior FY -> all returns/payments electronic. Annual filers (IT-101A) = employers withholding < 600 USD/yr or certain domestic/household employers; IT-103 not needed if IT-101A filed. Nonresident employers with employees in WV must withhold. No withholding: (1) bona fide residents of KY, MD, OH, PA, VA with WV/IT-104 on file; (2) nonresident whose WV duties are 30 days or less, performed in more than one state, not athlete/entertainer/public figure (employee to confirm home state has similar exclusion or no income tax); (3) nonresident US Armed Forces members (not National Guard under 32 USC 502). Allocation by time-and-attendance system or employee written statement of expected WV days. Full-time/part-time/temporary withholding identical. Local copy of US-MULTI-015.

instrument_name: WV IT-104 Employee's Withholding Exemption Certificate and WV/IT-104NR Certificate of Nonresidence (Rev. 03/2023)
figure_or_rule_carried: WV-specific certificate (federal W-4 not used). Lines: 1 single exemption (0/1); 2 married exemptions (0/1/2); 3 dependents; 4 total exemptions; 5 checkbox 'one earner/one job' (single, HoH, or married with non-working spouse, one job) -> lower-rate optional table; 6 additional withholding per pay period. IT-104NR: residents of KY, MD, OH, PA, VA whose only WV income is wages, and MSRRA military spouses (attach spouse military ID) -> employer stops WV withholding; employee must notify within 10 days if status changes. Edition Rev. 03/2023 is the one linked on the 2026 rate-cut page as current.

instrument_name: WV Tax Division - 2026 Income Tax Rate Cut page (SB 392, 2026)
article_or_section: 2026 Income Tax Rate Cut; W. Va. Code 11-21-4j
figure_or_rule_carried: SB 392 signed 2026-03-31; 11-21-4j codified effective 2026-06-12 with 5% across-the-board cut retroactive to 2026-01-01. Rates (single/joint/HoH): <=10,000 2.11%; 10,000-25,000 211.00 + 2.81%; 25,000-40,000 632.50 + 3.16%; 40,000-60,000 1,106.50 + 4.22%; >60,000 1,950.50 + 4.58%. MFS: halves (5,000/12,500/20,000/30,000; 105.50/316.25/553.25/975.25). Withholding tables updated for 2026 (IT-100.2.A, IT-100.2.B, IT-104). instrument_name: WV IT-105 Electronic Media Specifications W-2 (tax year 2025 edition)
article_or_section: Sections 1-10; RS and RV record layouts
figure_or_rule_carried: WV accepts EFW2 format only (512-byte .txt records, CR/LF delimiters, max 75,000 records per file); record set RA, RE, RW, RS (required for WV, state code '54' not 'WV'; state taxable wages and state income tax withheld at positions incl. 287-297), RT, RV (required: WV/IT-103 totals, money fields differ from standard EFW2), RF; every RE needs a matching RV. Upload via MyTaxes (mytaxes.wvtax.gov, Letter of Intent). IT-103 and W-2 data due January 31. E-file mandatory for payroll services or 10+ employees. 2026 edition (IT-105 2026) not yet listed on the forms page as of the 2026-10-09 copy.

instrument_name: WV/IT-101Q Employer's Quarterly Return of Income Tax Withheld (form and instructions)
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly return due last day of month after quarter, filed even with no employees/withholding. Fields: 1 number of employees; 2 wages, tips, other compensation; 3 WV tax withheld; 4-6 liability month 1/2/3; 7 quarter total (= line 3); 8 payments; 9 balance due; 10 overpayment; final-wages date checkbox; amended box. All employers are monthly payers and quarterly filers except those withholding < 600 USD/yr or certain domestic/household employers. Payroll services / 10+ employees must file and pay electronically via MyTaxes ($25 per employee penalty). Bulk file IT-101Q via MyTaxes for periods after 2025-12-31.

instrument_name: W. Va. Code 21A-5-10 Experience ratings; debit balance account rates; surtax (Wayback copy 2025-02-18)
figure_or_rule_carried: Experienced (36 months chargeable) credit-balance employers: rate from Table II by reserve ratio (Col. B) and fund-solvency column (C-F): e.g. reserve 0.0-6.0% -> 4.5/3.5/2.5/1.5; 18.0%+ -> 1.5/0.5/0.0/0.0 (minimum 0.0%). Debit-balance employers: 5.5% (deficit up to 5% of average annual payroll), 6.5% (5%-10%), 7.5% (10% or more) [text also retains a superseded 1967 schedule]. (b) 1% surtax on wages for every debit-balance employer and for foreign construction-trade entities in their first 36 months -> foreign construction initial 7.5% + 1% = 8.5% (derived; reconciles the handbook 8.5% with 21A-5-5(c) 7.5%). Overall range 0.0% to 8.5%, before the 2026 SB 1053 7% reduction (US-WVS5-002). Copy predates any 2026 amendment of this section (none found in SB 1053). Agency does not publish the yearly applicable Column on the pages read.

instrument_name: WorkForce West Virginia Employer Handbook (Rev. 06.24) - registration, new hire, quarterly wages, domestic exemption
figure_or_rule_carried: Register via business4wv.gov when employing in WV. Domestic employers paying each worker < 1,000 USD per quarter need not register. New hires AND rehires (not employed in prior 60 days) reported to the WV New Hire Reporting Center within 14 days of hire regardless of hours; fields: full name, mailing address, date of birth, SSN (employee without SSN must apply within 7 days and give the employer a copy). Quarterly wage report: wages reported in the quarter paid; includes salary, commissions, bonuses, reportable tips, vacation/holiday pay, gross pay incl. 401(k)/cafeteria deductions, required on-site meals/lodging if >= 25% of compensation, corporate-officer draws/distributions in lieu of W-2 wages, sick pay (first 6 months); excludes jury pay not reported for income tax, death benefits, stock options exercised, severance and pay in lieu of notice, employer-paid 401(k) match/insurance, approved SUB pay, enrolled student workers. Requests for separation/wage info must be returned within 4 days. Reimbursable option for 501(c)(3), government, public schools. Same file as US-WV-P5-2-004.
